regions.name: Ashen Keep
regions.subtitle: Seat of the Fallen Crown
regions.description: An ancient fortress rebuilt upon the ruins of a fallen kingdom. Merchants, smiths, and wandering warriors gather here before venturing into the wild lands beyond its walls.

regions.name: Whispering Woods
regions.subtitle: Forest of Forgotten Paths
regions.description: An ancient forest filled with twisted roots, forgotten shrines, and voices carried through the trees. Travelers who wander too far from the paths are rarely seen again.

regions.name: Ironspine Peaks
regions.subtitle: Mountains of Steel
regions.description: A jagged mountain range rich with forgotten mines and ancient dwarven ruins. The bitter winds conceal creatures adapted to the unforgiving heights.

regions.name: Sunken Reach
regions.subtitle: Ruins Beneath the Mist
regions.description: A drowned kingdom slowly consumed by black marshes. Half-buried temples rise from the fog while the restless dead patrol roads that no longer lead anywhere.

regions.name: Frostveil
regions.subtitle: The Eternal Winter
regions.description: Beyond the northern passes lies a frozen wasteland where the sun barely rises. Great beasts roam beneath violent snowstorms and forgotten citadels remain buried beneath the ice.

regions.name: Ember Wastes
regions.subtitle: Land of Burning Stone
regions.description: A scorched land formed by ancient volcanic eruptions. Rivers of molten stone cut through blackened valleys while creatures born from flame guard the ruins of forgotten fire temples.

regions.name: Dragonfall Crater
regions.subtitle: Grave of the First Dragon
regions.description: A colossal crater said to mark the place where the first great dragon fell from the heavens. The land remains warped by its ancient power and only the strongest warriors dare enter.

regions.name: The Voidscar
regions.subtitle: Where the World Broke
regions.description: A shattered region where reality itself has begun to collapse. Strange creatures emerge from fractures in the earth and ancient structures float above a landscape consumed by darkness.
